section: Prominent Andhra leaders - Konda Venkatappayya, Pattabhi Sitaramayya, Tanguturi Prakasam, Bulusu Sambamurthy
subsections: Bulusu Sambamurthy - Congress session role, posts held
Pattabhi Sitaramayya - presidential contest, session presided, first Telugu INC president

accepted.s: Who chaired the Reception Committee of the Indian National Congress session held at Kakinada in 1923?
accepted.x: Bulusu Sambamurthy was the Chairman of the Reception Committee of the Kakinada Congress session held in 1923.
accepted.tq: Use the post-person association and distinguish a session organiser from a Congress president.
accepted.sec: Bulusu Sambamurthy - Congress session role, posts held

accepted.s: Bulusu Sambamurthy toured the whole of Andhra primarily to mobilise public support for which of the following?
o: Boycott of the Round Table Conference
Acceptance of the Cabinet Mission Plan
accepted.x: Bulusu Sambamurthy toured Andhra calling for a boycott of the Simon Commission.
accepted.tq: Match the leader with the specific nationalist campaign rather than a similar constitutional event.
accepted.sec: Bulusu Sambamurthy - Congress session role, posts held

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding Bulusu Sambamurthy:
1. He supported the boycott of elections associated with the Non-Cooperation Movement in 1920.
2. He attended the Vijayawada meeting of the All India Congress Committee in 1921.
3. He was a coastal signatory to the Sribagh Pact.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. Sambamurthy supported the 1920 election boycott, attended the Vijayawada AICC meeting in 1921 and signed the Sribagh Pact as a coastal representative.
accepted.tq: Check each statement independently, especially the sequence of 1920, 1921 and the Sribagh Pact.
accepted.sec: Bulusu Sambamurthy - Congress session role, posts held

accepted.s: Bulusu Sambamurthy held which constitutional office in 1937?
o: Speaker of the Andhra Legislative Assembly
Leader of the Legislative Council of Madras
President of the Madras Congress Committee
accepted.x: Bulusu Sambamurthy became the Speaker of the Madras Assembly in 1937.
accepted.tq: Identify the correct legislative body and avoid substituting an Andhra provincial institution for the Madras Assembly.
accepted.sec: Bulusu Sambamurthy - Congress session role, posts held

accepted.s: Which of the following statements correctly describes the position taken by Bulusu Sambamurthy regarding the Andhra State?
o: The Andhra State must be formed before the Constitution came into force.
The formation of Andhra State should be postponed until after independence.
The Andhra State should be formed only after the Constitution came into force.
The Andhra State should be formed only after the linguistic reorganisation of all provinces.
accepted.x: As Speaker of the Madras Assembly, Sambamurthy declared that Andhra State must be formed before the Constitution came into force.
accepted.tq: Focus on the time condition in the statement; the constitutional deadline is the decisive clue.
accepted.sec: Bulusu Sambamurthy - Congress session role, posts held

accepted.s:
Arrange the following events associated with Bulusu Sambamurthy in chronological order:
A. Attendance at the Vijayawada AICC meeting
B. Support for the Non-Cooperation Movement election boycott
C. Chairmanship of the Kakinada Congress Reception Committee
D. Speakership of the Madras Assembly
accepted.x: The correct order is the 1920 election boycott, the 1921 Vijayawada AICC meeting, the 1923 Kakinada session and the 1937 speakership.
accepted.tq: Fix the dated events first and then arrange the intervening Congress activities.
accepted.sec: Bulusu Sambamurthy - Congress session role, posts held

accepted.s: In the Tripuri Congress presidential contest of 1939, Pattabhi Sitaramayya was the candidate supported by whom?
accepted.x: Pattabhi Sitaramayya contested the 1939 Tripuri presidential election as Gandhi's candidate and was defeated by Subhas Chandra Bose.
accepted.tq: Use the candidate-supporter pairing, a common leader-and-deed trap in history questions.
accepted.sec: Pattabhi Sitaramayya - presidential contest, session presided, first Telugu INC president  [APPSC]

accepted.s: After Pattabhi Sitaramayya was defeated by Subhas Chandra Bose in the 1939 Tripuri Congress contest, Gandhi described the result as:
o: a defeat of the Civil Disobedience Movement
the triumph of provincial Congress committees
accepted.x: Gandhi regarded Pattabhi's defeat as his own defeat because Pattabhi had been his candidate.
accepted.tq: Link the political outcome with the exact interpretation given by the principal campaigner.
accepted.sec: Pattabhi Sitaramayya - presidential contest, session presided, first Telugu INC president  [APPSC]

accepted.s: With which of the following committees was Pattabhi Sitaramayya associated?
accepted.x: Pattabhi Sitaramayya served on the JVP Committee, consisting of Jawaharlal Nehru, Vallabhbhai Patel and Pattabhi Sitaramayya.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure member pairing and reject committees containing leaders not associated with the body.
accepted.sec: Pattabhi Sitaramayya - presidential contest, session presided, first Telugu INC president  [APPSC]

accepted.s: What was the initial position of the JVP Committee on the creation of linguistic States?
o: It rejected the idea of linguistic States at the initial stage.
It transferred the decision exclusively to the princely States.
It immediately recommended linguistic States throughout India.
It recommended linguistic States only for the Madras Presidency.
accepted.x: The JVP Committee, comprising Nehru, Patel and Pattabhi, initially rejected the demand for linguistic States.
accepted.tq: Test the committee's initial recommendation rather than its membership or later developments.
accepted.sec: Pattabhi Sitaramayya - presidential contest, session presided, first Telugu INC president  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
o: Pattabhi Sitaramayya — Krishna Jilla Co-operative Bank
accepted.x: Pattabhi Sitaramayya founded Andhra Bank, Andhra Insurance Company and the Krishna Jilla Co-operative Bank. The Simon Commission campaign is associated here with Bulusu Sambamurthy, not with Pattabhi's founding activities.
accepted.tq: Find the single mismatched leader-and-association pair among closely related Andhra nationalist facts.
accepted.sec: Pattabhi Sitaramayya - presidential contest, session presided, first Telugu INC president  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Andhra Bank was founded by Pattabhi Sitaramayya at which place and in which year?
accepted.x: Pattabhi Sitaramayya founded Andhra Bank at Machilipatnam in 1923.
accepted.tq: Combine the location and year; both must be correct to identify the answer.
accepted.sec: Pattabhi Sitaramayya - presidential contest, session presided, first Telugu INC president  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The head office of Andhra Bank founded by Pattabhi Sitaramayya was known as:
accepted.x: The head office of Andhra Bank was known as Pattabhi Bhavan.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between a founder's name and generic institutional names used as distractors.
accepted.sec: Pattabhi Sitaramayya - presidential contest, session presided, first Telugu INC president  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following statements about Pattabhi Sitaramayya is correct?
o: He founded Andhra Bank, Andhra Insurance Company and the Krishna Jilla Co-operative Bank.
He founded only Andhra Bank and opposed cooperative banking institutions.
He founded the Simon Commission campaign and the JVP Committee.
He founded the Swarajya newspaper and the Krishna Patrika.
accepted.x: Pattabhi Sitaramayya founded Andhra Bank, Andhra Insurance Company and the Krishna Jilla Co-operative Bank. The other options attribute unrelated activities to him.
accepted.tq: Choose the complete and precise association while rejecting swapped founder-and-organisation claims.
accepted.sec: Pattabhi Sitaramayya - presidential contest, session presided, first Telugu INC president  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which statement best reflects the historical qualification concerning the description of Pattabhi Sitaramayya as the first Telugu president of the Indian National Congress?
o: P. Ananda Charlu and Pattabhi jointly presided over the same Congress session in 1891.
Pattabhi presided over the Congress before P. Ananda Charlu in 1891.
P. Ananda Charlu presided over the Congress in 1891, although Pattabhi is treated as the first Telugu INC president in the cited APPSC convention.
No Telugu leader presided over the Congress before independence.
accepted.x: P. Ananda Charlu presided over the Congress in 1891. Nevertheless, the APPSC convention identifies Pattabhi Sitaramayya as the first Telugu INC president when Ananda Charlu is not an option.
accepted.tq: Separate the examination convention from the strict historical qualification instead of treating similar claims as identical.
accepted.sec: Pattabhi Sitaramayya - presidential contest, session presided, first Telugu INC president  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following combinations correctly represents the JVP Committee?
o: Jawaharlal Nehru, Vallabhbhai Patel and Pattabhi Sitaramayya
Mahatma Gandhi, Subhas Chandra Bose and Pattabhi Sitaramayya
Jawaharlal Nehru, Tanguturi Prakasam and Bulusu Sambamurthy
Vallabhbhai Patel, Rajendra Prasad and P. Ananda Charlu
accepted.x: The JVP Committee consisted of Jawaharlal Nehru, Vallabhbhai Patel and Pattabhi Sitaramayya.
accepted.tq: Use the initials-based committee name and verify all three members rather than one member alone.
accepted.sec: Pattabhi Sitaramayya - presidential contest, session presided, first Telugu INC president  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following pairs:
1. Tanguturi Prakasam — First Chief Minister of Andhra State
2. Prakasam district — Named after Tanguturi Prakasam
3. Andhra Bank — Symbol of Swadeshi enterprise
4. Bulusu Sambamurthy — Leader associated with the Simon Commission boycott in Andhra
Which of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
accepted.x: All four pairs are correctly matched. Prakasam was the first Chief Minister of Andhra State, the district bears his name, Andhra Bank represented Swadeshi enterprise, and Sambamurthy led the Andhra campaign for boycotting the Simon Commission.
accepted.tq: Verify each leader, place and institution association without reversing the direction of the relationship.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly identifies the collective historical significance of Konda Venkatappayya, Pattabhi Sitaramayya, Tanguturi Prakasam and Bulusu Sambamurthy?
o: They led Andhra-related activities connected with the Non-Cooperation Movement, Civil Disobedience Movement, Simon Commission boycott, Sribagh Pact and the demand for Statehood.
They were exclusively administrators of the Madras Presidency and did not participate in mass movements.
They were all presidents of the Indian National Congress in successive years.
They were associated only with the linguistic reorganisation of States after 1956.
accepted.x: These four leaders collectively guided Andhra's political activities connected with the Non-Cooperation and Civil Disobedience Movements, Simon Commission boycott, Sribagh Pact and the demand for Statehood.
accepted.tq: Select the option covering the full range of activities and reject the extreme word exclusively.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: Which district of Andhra Pradesh is named after Tanguturi Prakasam?
accepted.x: Prakasam district is named after Tanguturi Prakasam.
accepted.tq: Distinguish an eponymous district from distractors formed from the names of other Andhra leaders.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: The founding of Andhra Bank in 1923 is regarded as an example of which broader idea in the Andhra nationalist context?
o: Official expansion of the Madras Government
accepted.x: Andhra Bank, founded in 1923, represented the spirit of Swadeshi enterprise in Andhra.
accepted.tq: Connect the institution with the underlying nationalist economic concept rather than its administrative location.
accepted.sec: Universal angles
